rationale: The expression is internally consistent and the quality gate is a legitimate conditional refinement of the known net-payout/share-issuance anomaly, but zeroing out low-quality firms perversely removes the most informative short-leg candidates (cash-poor issuers) and leaves the short leg populated by high-quality issuers, so the interaction may weaken rather than sharpen the base effect.

This is close to a direct rediscovery of the well-documented earnings-management-around-equity-issuance result (Teoh-Welch-Wong, plus the Sloan accrual and Pontiff-Woodgate issuance anomalies), and mechanically the variable is exactly zero for the large majority of firms (non-issuers and non-gated firms), so decile sorts will be dominated by ties and the "long leg" carries no economic content.

The asymmetric double gate is coherently constructed and the stated sign matches the expression's direction, though it partially double-counts issuance (already inside prstkc-sstk), overlaps heavily with the other payout-gated proposals in this batch, and its added complexity may buy little beyond a gross-profitability-tilted net-payout sort.

Because net payout/assets is almost always far smaller than operating cash flow/assets, the MIN will equal the payout term for the overwhelming majority of firms, so the "complementarity" is mechanically inert and the signal collapses into the known net-payout-yield anomaly.

Persistence-weighted payout interacted with durable cash profitability is a defensible non-additive construct, but the 0-5 integer multiplier means cross-sectional variation is largely driven by cash-based operating profitability (a published anomaly), non-repurchasers pile up at exactly zero regardless of quality, and negative-OCF persistent repurchasers land in the extreme short leg by accident of sign rather than design.

Beyond overlapping the established debt-issuance/asset-growth anomalies conditioned on the standard RE/AT lifecycle proxy, the construction is degenerate (a large exact-zero mass for all non-gated firms) and the sign is ambiguous in the deleveraging tail, where distressed firms shrinking debt receive the highest scores for reasons the hypothesis never justifies.
